US.vat_gst_rate: 0% Federal (State Sales Tax 0-10.25% collected by marketplace)
US.recommendation_summary: Easiest expansion market due to high $800 de minimis threshold. Low-value shipments clear customs duty-free and tax-free with minimal clearance overhead under Section 321.

UK.simplification_scheme: HMRC Low Value Consignment Scheme (Marketplace VAT remittance)
UK.recommendation_summary: Highly viable market. For orders under £135, marketplaces (Amazon, eBay) collect VAT at checkout, eliminating customs clearance delays for foreign sellers.

EU.simplification_scheme: Import One-Stop Shop (IOSS) for consignments up to €150
EU.estimated_duty_rate: 0% duty under €150; VAT mandatory on all commercial imports from €0
EU.recommendation_summary: Moderate friction. While €0 de minimis means all goods incur VAT, using IOSS enables unified monthly VAT filing across all 27 EU nations without individual country registrations.

JP.simplification_scheme: Simplified Tariff Schedule for consignments under ¥200,000
JP.estimated_duty_rate: Simplified flat tariff 3-5% or duty-free under ¥10,000
JP.recommendation_summary: Moderate-high friction. Japanese labeling (MAH requirement) is strictly enforced. However, consignments under ¥10,000 CIF value are exempt from customs duty and Consumption Tax.

CA.vat_gst_rate: 5% Federal GST + provincial taxes (PST/HST up to 15%)
CA.simplification_scheme: CARM (CBSA Assessment and Revenue Management) portal
CA.estimated_duty_rate: Avg 5-8% plus combined GST/HST on almost all parcels
CA.recommendation_summary: Highest friction market for small cross-border sellers. Lowest de minimis threshold ($20 CAD for non-US/MX goods) triggers tax, CBSA carrier handling fees, and mandatory English/French bilingual labeling.

AU.vat_gst_rate: 10% Australian GST (collected by marketplace for low value goods)
AU.simplification_scheme: Simplified GST Law for Low Value Imported Goods (LVIG under $1,000 AUD)
AU.recommendation_summary: Very attractive expansion market. High $1,000 AUD customs duty de minimis threshold allows seamless duty-free entry for consumer e-commerce orders, with 10% GST handled directly by marketplaces.

IN.de_minimis_currency: INR (Gift exemption limited to personal consignments under ₹1,000)
IN.vat_gst_rate: 18% standard IGST (Integrated Goods and Services Tax)
IN.simplification_scheme: ICEGATE Indian Customs Electronic Data Interchange Gateway
IN.estimated_duty_rate: Avg 10-20% Basic Customs Duty + 18% IGST + 10% Social Welfare Surcharge
IN.recommendation_summary: High friction market for direct consumer import. Formal customs clearance through ICEGATE, mandatory Legal Metrology declarations, and strict BIS/CDSCO compliance for toys and cosmetics.

CN.de_minimis_currency: CNY (Duty waiver if total tariff is under 50 RMB)
CN.vat_gst_rate: 13% standard VAT (9.1% preferential comprehensive tax for CBEC cross-border channel)
CN.simplification_scheme: Cross-Border E-Commerce (CBEC) Positive List Scheme (Bonded Warehouse / Direct Mail)
CN.estimated_duty_rate: 0% tariff + 70% of standard VAT/Consumption Tax (Effective 9.1% rate for CBEC transactions up to ¥5,000)
CN.recommendation_summary: Attractive through designated CBEC channels (Tmall Global, JD Worldwide) with reduced 9.1% integrated tax and exemption from initial NMPA cosmetic filing, but general trade incurs full CCC and GB standard inspections.

DE.simplification_scheme: EU Import One-Stop Shop (IOSS) for shipments up to €150
DE.estimated_duty_rate: 0% duty under €150; 19% import VAT collected at checkout via IOSS
DE.recommendation_summary: Robust e-commerce hub within the EU single market. Strict environmental compliance enforcement (VerpackG LUCID registration and ElektroG WEEE compliance are mandatory for all marketplace sellers).

VN.simplification_scheme: VNACCS/VCIS Vietnam Automated Cargo and Port Consolidated System
VN.estimated_duty_rate: Duty-free under 1,000,000 VND; standard tariffs (15-30%) and 10% VAT above threshold
VN.recommendation_summary: Rapidly growing e-commerce destination with a 1,000,000 VND de minimis exemption. Consignments above threshold require formal import clearance, Vietnamese sub-labeling, and CR marks for children's goods.

BR.simplification_scheme: Remessa Conforme Program (Expedited pre-cleared e-commerce portal)
BR.estimated_duty_rate: 20% under $50 USD (Remessa Conforme); 60% import tariff above $50 USD
BR.recommendation_summary: High tariff environment. Enroll in Remessa Conforme program for expedited customs pre-clearance and 20% federal tariff for parcels under $50 USD; otherwise standard 60% tariff applies.
